It would be of great help as we have plenty of missing values on the linear variable (~ 400 out of 1600 cases) and WLSMV does pairwise deletion, right?

Now, we will treat the items in our model as linear variables and use FIML. But this is not ideal as there are some dichotomous items in the model and some of the ordered items in the model show floor effects.

cheers,
Michael

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: estimator="PML" can not handle mixed continuous and ordinal data (yet)
parts:
On 01/16/2015 03:44 PM, Michael Paul Grosz wrote:
> It would be of great help as we have plenty of missing values on the
> linear variable (~ 400 out of 1600 cases) and WLSMV does pairwise
> deletion, right?

Right.

But PML (as currently implement, 0.5-17) does not handle missing data
either. There is work in progress to handle missing data, but *not* for
the mixed (ordered + continuous) case, so that will not be an option (in
lavaan) any time soon.

I would suggest to have a look at multiple imputation. There are some
nice routines for this in the semTools package.

Yves.
